# Hermes shared source snapshot

This directory contains a fixed, unmodified runtime source snapshot of `apps/shared` from NousResearch/hermes-agent, with the upstream MIT license. `UPSTREAM.json` records its commit, tree and SHA-256 hashes. The repository attributes preserve snapshot bytes across Windows and Unix checkouts. Upstream tests are excluded; the Web suite verifies the consumed behavior.

Application, TypeScript and Vitest all use this copy, including when developing inside the full Hermes checkout. Normal installation/build never reads a sibling Hermes repository or fetches upstream.

Do not edit the copied protocol or client directly. For an intentional update, obtain a Hermes checkout and select a reviewed commit, then run from the Web repository root:

```powershell
pnpm sync:shared --source "D:/path/to/hermes-agent" --ref "the-reviewed-commit-sha"
pnpm install
pnpm typecheck
pnpm test
pnpm build
```

The maintenance command reads committed Git objects, not the source checkout's uncommitted files. It refuses to overwrite copied files whose hashes no longer match their provenance. Review and commit the snapshot, metadata and any lockfile change together. The parent `apps/shared` remains untouched. Generated contract files are copied as supplied, never regenerated by this command.
